  final class RecordFundTAConfirmedRule(hosts: FundOrderComputations)
      extends InvariantRule[Event, State, RecordFundTAConfirmedParams] {
    override def apply(state: State, p: RecordFundTAConfirmedParams): Either[iMadzError, List[Event]] = {
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundTAConfirmed/TA_ORDER@8f7cfe2aac5249c1
      if (!((p.fundOrderId == state.id))) Left(iMadzError("TA_ORDER", "TA 回执目标订单标识必须与当前聚合一致"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundTAConfirmed/TA_PAYMENT@d835019fa66e1469
      else if (!(((p.paymentTxId == state.selectedPaymentTxId) && ((state.cashPaymentFinalResults).get(p.paymentTxId)).contains("succeeded")))) Left(iMadzError("TA_PAYMENT", "TA 回执对应的支付交易号必须与已成功支付交易一致"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundTAConfirmed/TA_REQUEST@0d2e741cbb2fb100
      else if (!(((p.taRequestId == state.taRequestId) && ((p.taRequestId).value).nonEmpty))) Left(iMadzError("TA_REQUEST", "TA 请求单号不能为空且必须与订单已登记单号一致"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundTAConfirmed/TA_REFERENCE@3aeeecfe7c21e6da
      else if (!(((p.taReference).nonEmpty && ((state.taReference).isEmpty || (state.taReference == p.taReference))))) Left(iMadzError("TA_REFERENCE", "TA 参考号不能为空且不能与已记录参考号冲突"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundTAConfirmed/TA_FUND@b61df0aed6a95c6b
      else if (!(((p.fundCode == state.fundCode) && (p.currency == (state.amount).currency)))) Left(iMadzError("TA_FUND", "TA 回执的基金代码与币种必须与订单一致"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundTAConfirmed/TA_RECEIPT_PRESENT@37c8818d11c7bb2c
      else if (!(((p.receiptId).nonEmpty && (p.receiptBody).nonEmpty))) Left(iMadzError("TA_RECEIPT_PRESENT", "TA 回执编号与回执原文均不能为空"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundTAConfirmed/TA_RECEIPT_CONFLICT@8a759ed79e37bc4b
      else if (!((!((state.taReceipts).contains(p.receiptId)) || (((state.taReceipts)(p.receiptId) == p.receiptBody) && ((state.taReceiptOutcomes).get(p.receiptId)).contains("confirmed"))))) Left(iMadzError("TA_RECEIPT_CONFLICT", "同一 TA 回执编号对应的原文或结果与历史记录冲突"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundTAConfirmed/TA_RECEIPT_ONCE@4cd1f67ea0e37b97
      else if (((state.taReceipts).contains(p.receiptId))) Right(Nil)
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundTAConfirmed/TA_TERMINAL_CONFLICT@d3763e61c367509d
      else if (!(((state.taStatus != "confirmed") && (state.taStatus != "rejected")))) Left(iMadzError("TA_TERMINAL_CONFLICT", "订单 TA 状态已达终态，禁止写入冲突终态结果"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundTAConfirmed/TA_SHARE_FUND@1904035b9107bb90
      else if (!(((((p.shares).fundCode == state.fundCode) && (((p.shares).shares).value).nonEmpty) && (((p.shares).nav).value).nonEmpty))) Left(iMadzError("TA_SHARE_FUND", "确认份额的基金代码须匹配订单且份额与净值均不能为空"))
      else Right(List(FundTASharesConfirmed(p.fundOrderId, p.paymentTxId, p.taRequestId, p.taReference, p.receiptId, p.receiptBody, p.fundCode, p.currency, p.shares, "confirmed", state.tenantId)))
    }
  }

    override def apply(state: State, p: RequestFundPurchaseRefundParams): Either[iMadzError, List[Event]] = {
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RequestFundPurchaseRefund/REFUND_RESOURCE@eb3571946bf66862
      if (!((p.fundOrderId == state.id))) Left(iMadzError("REFUND_RESOURCE", "退款申请目标订单标识必须与当前聚合一致"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RequestFundPurchaseRefund/REFUND_PAYMENT@272c31d38326adf9
      else if (!(((p.paymentTxId == state.selectedPaymentTxId) && ((state.cashPaymentFinalResults).get(p.paymentTxId)).contains("succeeded")))) Left(iMadzError("REFUND_PAYMENT", "退款申请关联的支付交易必须已成功完成"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RequestFundPurchaseRefund/REFUND_TA_REJECTED@7bd3712b2ad2f524
      else if (!((state.taStatus == "rejected"))) Left(iMadzError("REFUND_TA_REJECTED", "仅 TA 确认拒绝的订单允许发起申购退款"))

      else if (!(((state.refundOperationId).value).isEmpty)) Right(Nil)
      else for {
        stableRefundOperationId <- hosts.stableRefundOperationId(state, p)
      } yield List(FundPurchaseRefundRequested(p.fundOrderId, p.paymentTxId, state.investorAccountId, state.fundCollectionAccountId, state.amount, stableRefundOperationId, state.tenantId))

  final class RecordFundRefundSucceededRule(hosts: FundOrderComputations)
      extends InvariantRule[Event, State, RecordFundRefundSucceededParams] {
    override def apply(state: State, p: RecordFundRefundSucceededParams): Either[iMadzError, List[Event]] = {
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundRefundSucceeded/REFUND_RESULT_ASSOCIATION@bce0496d61455429
      if (!(((p.refundOperationId == state.refundOperationId) && ((p.refundOperationId).value).nonEmpty))) Left(iMadzError("REFUND_RESULT_ASSOCIATION", "退款结果关联的退款操作号不能为空且须与订单一致"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundRefundSucceeded/REFUND_RECEIPT_PRESENT@ae1e23232c54550c
      else if (!(((((p.refundTxId).value).nonEmpty && (p.receiptId).nonEmpty) && (p.receiptBody).nonEmpty))) Left(iMadzError("REFUND_RECEIPT_PRESENT", "退款交易号、回执编号及回执原文均不能为空"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundRefundSucceeded/REFUND_RECEIPT_CONFLICT@4ac7494712cc4fb4
      else if (!((!((state.refundResultReceipts).contains(p.receiptId)) || ((state.refundResultReceipts)(p.receiptId) == p.receiptBody)))) Left(iMadzError("REFUND_RECEIPT_CONFLICT", "同一退款回执编号对应的回执原文与历史记录冲突"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundRefundSucceeded/REFUND_TERMINAL_CONFLICT@cf83c7e8857a91ac
      else if (!((!((state.refundFinalResults).contains(p.refundTxId)) || ((state.refundFinalResults)(p.refundTxId) == "succeeded")))) Left(iMadzError("REFUND_TERMINAL_CONFLICT", "退款终态结果已落账且与新上报结果冲突"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundRefundSucceeded/REFUND_RECEIPT_ONCE@cb66606d82250459
      else if (((state.refundResultReceipts).contains(p.receiptId))) Right(Nil)
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundRefundSucceeded/REFUND_TERMINAL_ONCE@b3f9df3de14b44b8
      else if (((state.refundFinalResults).contains(p.refundTxId))) Right(Nil)
      else Right(List(FundRefundSucceeded(p.refundTxId, p.refundOperationId, p.receiptId, p.receiptBody, "succeeded", state.tenantId)))
    }
  }

      if (!(((p.refundOperationId == state.refundOperationId) && ((p.refundOperationId).value).nonEmpty))) Left(iMadzError("REFUND_RESULT_ASSOCIATION", "退款结果关联的退款操作号不能为空且须与订单一致"))

      else if (!(((((p.refundTxId).value).nonEmpty && (p.receiptId).nonEmpty) && (p.receiptBody).nonEmpty))) Left(iMadzError("REFUND_RECEIPT_PRESENT", "退款交易号、回执编号及回执原文均不能为空"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundRefundOutcomeUnknown/REFUND_RECEIPT_CONFLICT@4ac7494712cc4fb4
      else if (!((!((state.refundResultReceipts).contains(p.receiptId)) || ((state.refundResultReceipts)(p.receiptId) == p.receiptBody)))) Left(iMadzError("REFUND_RECEIPT_CONFLICT", "同一退款回执编号对应的回执原文与历史记录冲突"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundRefundOutcomeUnknown/REFUND_RECEIPT_ONCE@cb66606d82250459
      else if (((state.refundResultReceipts).contains(p.receiptId))) Right(Nil)
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundRefundOutcomeUnknown/REFUND_LATE_PROGRESS@fe016e93470ee941
      else if (((state.refundFinalResults).contains(p.refundTxId))) Right(Nil)
      else Right(List(FundRefundOutcomeUnknown(p.refundTxId, p.refundOperationId, p.receiptId, p.receiptBody, "outcome-unknown", state.tenantId)))
    }
  }
  // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/command/FundOrder/RecordCashRequestSource@fc62cc642aea6121
  final class RecordCashRequestSourceRule(hosts: FundOrderComputations)
      extends InvariantRule[Event, State, RecordCashRequestSourceParams] {
    override def apply(state: State, p: RecordCashRequestSourceParams): Either[iMadzError, List[Event]] = {
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordCashRequestSource/CASH_SOURCE_OPTION@8d5cd42c66dae2cd
      if (!((p.source).contains(p.original))) Left(iMadzError("CASH_SOURCE_OPTION", "现金申购来源包装项必须与原始来源记录一致"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordCashRequestSource/CASH_SOURCE_RESOURCE@e43393ec335bca0c
      else if (!(((p.original).fundOrderId == state.id))) Left(iMadzError("CASH_SOURCE_RESOURCE", "现金申购来源中的订单标识必须与当前聚合一致"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordCashRequestSource/CASH_SOURCE_BODY@971346caf9b36c72
      else if (!(((((((((p.original).principalId).nonEmpty && ((p.original).clientRequestId).nonEmpty) && ((p.original).authorityVersion).nonEmpty) && (((p.original).operationId).value).nonEmpty) && ((p.original).fundCode).nonEmpty) && (((p.original).amount).currency == "CNY")) && (((p.original).amount).amount > BigDecimal("0.00"))))) Left(iMadzError("CASH_SOURCE_BODY", "现金申购来源的主体、请求号、版本、操作号、基金代码与 CNY 正金额均须有效"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordCashRequestSource/CASH_SOURCE_CONFLICT@9249ddb91600e58b
      else if (!(((state.cashRequestSource).isEmpty || (state.cashRequestSource).contains(p.original)))) Left(iMadzError("CASH_SOURCE_CONFLICT", "该订单已登记不同的现金申购原始来源记录"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordCashRequestSource/CASH_SOURCE_PAYMENT@ac741fcb3660199f
      else if (!(((state.status == "new") || ((((((p.original).operationId == state.operationId) && ((p.original).investorAccountId == state.investorAccountId)) && ((p.original).fundCollectionAccountId == state.fundCollectionAccountId)) && ((p.original).fundCode == state.fundCode)) && ((((p.original).amount).currency == (state.amount).currency) && (((p.original).amount).amount == (state.amount).amount)))))) Left(iMadzError("CASH_SOURCE_PAYMENT", "现金申购来源内容必须与已登记结算请求保持一致"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordCashRequestSource/CASH_SOURCE_ONCE@4e2ce655112ab1cf
      else if (!((state.cashRequestSource).isEmpty)) Right(Nil)
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordCashRequestSource/CASH_SOURCE_BEFORE_SETTLEMENT@74823ab61e4a8f86
      else if (!((state.status == "new"))) Left(iMadzError("CASH_SOURCE_BEFORE_SETTLEMENT", "现金申购来源必须在发起结算请求之前登记"))
      else Right(List(CashRequestSourceRecorded(p.original, p.source, state.tenantId)))
    }
  }

  def checkEventPostconditions(events: List[Event]): Option[iMadzError] =
    events.iterator.map(checkEventPostcondition).collectFirst { case Some(error) => error }

    case e: FundPurchaseSettlementRequested =>

      else if (Option(e.amount).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "FundPurchaseSettlementRequested.amount 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: ReserveFundSubscriptionConfirmed =>

      else if (Option(e.principal).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "FundTAReceiptObserved.principal 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.receiptId).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "FundTAReceiptObserved.receiptId 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.receiptBody).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "FundTAReceiptObserved.receiptBody 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.taReference).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "FundTAReceiptObserved.taReference 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.status).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "FundTAReceiptObserved.status 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.shares).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "FundTAReceiptObserved.shares 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.nav).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "FundTAReceiptObserved.nav 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.reason).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "FundTAReceiptObserved.reason 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: BankPaymentResultSucceeded =>
      if (Option(e.txid).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "BankPaymentResultSucceeded.txid 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: BankPaymentResultRejectedBeforeEffects =>
      if (Option(e.txid).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "BankPaymentResultRejectedBeforeEffects.txid 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: BankPaymentResultCompensated =>
      if (Option(e.txid).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "BankPaymentResultCompensated.txid 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: BankPaymentResultRecoveryRequired =>
      if (Option(e.txid).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "BankPaymentResultRecoveryRequired.txid 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: BankPaymentResultOutcomeUnknown =>
      if (Option(e.txid).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "BankPaymentResultOutcomeUnknown.txid 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: BankRefundResultSucceeded =>
      if (Option(e.txid).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "BankRefundResultSucceeded.txid 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: BankRefundResultRejectedBeforeEffects =>
      if (Option(e.txid).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "BankRefundResultRejectedBeforeEffects.txid 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: BankRefundResultCompensated =>
      if (Option(e.txid).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "BankRefundResultCompensated.txid 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: BankRefundResultRecoveryRequired =>
      if (Option(e.txid).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "BankRefundResultRecoveryRequired.txid 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: BankRefundResultOutcomeUnknown =>
      if (Option(e.txid).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "BankRefundResultOutcomeUnknown.txid 不能为空"))
      else None
    case e: CashRequestSourceRecorded =>
      if (Option(e.original).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "CashRequestSourceRecorded.original 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.source).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "CashRequestSourceRecorded.source 不能为空"))
      else if (Option(e.tenantId).isEmpty) Some(iMadzError("EVENT_POSTCONDITION_REQUIRED", "CashRequestSourceRecorded.tenantId 不能为空"))
      else None
    case _ => None
  }
}
